title: The Climbing One Rung and Stopping
youtube_title: The Climbing One Rung and Stopping | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Being new at something is not the same as failing.
summary: At a library story circle, Bodhi feels shy about an one rung of a ladder, and permission to stop there. Instead of pretending not to care, Bodhi tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie June stays kind and does not push for a show.
